lines.vo: The same study hours, spread out, tend to beat one big cram.
Jay splits his chapter into short sessions in his Study and Success Planner.
lines.cap: Jay splits his chapter into short sessions in his Study & Success Planner.

lines.vo: One review looked at three hundred seventeen spacing experiments.
lines.cap: One review looked at 317 spacing experiments.

lines.vo: Spreading sessions out usually led to better recall than cramming them together.
Each gap lets you forget a little, and pulling it back seems to make it stick.
So study a little today, and again in a few days.
Short sessions, check the box, it sticks. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Cramming is why you *forget* it all
